sources.title: GitHub - OmniJev/OneJev: A multimodal System One decision model that ...
sources.snippet: English · 简体中文 · 日本語 OneJev is a multimodal System One decision model. It returns calibrated probabilities for typed questions about screenshots, photos, videos and text in a single forward pass. Available in 0.8B, 4B, 9B and 27B.

sources.title: MedGemma — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: MedGemma 1.5 4B enables developers to more effectively adapt MedGemma for applications that involve high-dimensional imaging (CT, MRI, and whole slide histopathology), longitudinal analysis of chest X-rays, anatomical localization, and other medical imaging and text functionality.

sources.title: Google AI Releases MedGemma-1.5: The Latest Update to their Open ...
sources.snippet: Google Research has expanded its Health AI Developer Foundations program (HAI-DEF) with the release of MedGemma-1.5. The model is released as open starting points for developers who want to build medical imaging, text and speech systems and then adapt them to local workflows and regulations.
